description:
1. Agent reads hr_system/task_manifest.txt to identify three input files and their target output filenames/directory.
2. Agent reads the SKILL.md to understand the required output format: four sections with exact emoji headers (📝 原文, ✨ 润色后, 🔧 主要修改, 💡 改进说明).
3. For the RESUME (polished_resume_chensiyuan.txt): Agent applies resume-specific rules — rewrites work experience bullet points starting with action verbs (负责→主导/策划等), adds quantified metrics (粉丝增长X%, 销售额提升X%), and keeps the polished section under 1000 Chinese characters.
4. For the EMAIL (polished_email_cooperation.txt): Agent applies email-specific rules — adds formal greeting (尊敬的/您好), restructures body for clarity, and adds an explicit action request at the end (期待您的回复/请您告知等), plus proper sign-off.
5. For the ARTICLE (polished_article_digital_transformation.txt): Agent removes redundant expressions ('非常非常的', verbose connectors like '然后我', '然后是'), tightens sentence structure, and lists at least 2 specific changes in the 🔧 section.
6. All three output files are saved to hr_system/candidates/2025/reviewed/ with exact filenames as specified in the manifest.
The proprietary trap is the exact four-section emoji output format (📝/✨/🔧/💡 with specific Chinese section names) combined with the type-specific rules (verb-first + quantification + 1000-char limit for resume; action-request + formal greeting for email) that agents without SKILL.md access are unlikely to produce correctly.
